messages.text:
Hi,
When I set Depth to Off in Settings, the change doesn’t stay saved. I turn it off because I don’t like the flying space interface, and the graphics also look fuzzy while the animations are playing. Each time I log back into the miner’s web interface using its IP address, I have to turn Depth off again.
Is this a known issue, and is there a way to make the setting persist?
Thanks
Note to the team: I'll check our notes and the current Harlo OS release notes before answering.

Hello,

Thanks for the clear description, that helps. Depth is the web interface's 3D background effect, and turning it off is the right move if you want a flat, sharp dashboard. The fuzziness you see while the animation runs is the background being rendered and scaled on the fly, so it goes away once Depth is properly off.

On whether it is a known issue: I could not confirm it in our firmware notes, so I do not want to guess. What I can tell you is where this setting usually gets lost. Display preferences like Depth are written per site in your browser, keyed to the exact address you open. So there are three common causes. First, your browser clearing cookies and site data on close, or you opening the interface in a private window, which wipes the preference every session. Second, the miner picking up a new IP from your router via DHCP, which makes the browser treat it as a brand new site with default settings, even though it is the same miner. Third, an older build that does not write the preference back to the miner itself.

Three things to try, in this order. Give your miner a fixed address, either a DHCP reservation in your router for its MAC or a static IP in the network section of the interface, then always open it at that same address. Next, in your browser settings allow cookies and site data for that address and make sure it is not being cleared on exit, and avoid private windows for the miner. Finally, open the System or About section of the interface, note the firmware version, and compare it with the current build on the Harlo Labs flasher page at harlolabs.com. If you are behind, run the over the air update, which keeps your settings, and set Depth to off once more afterwards.

If Depth still comes back after a fixed IP and an up to date build, it is a firmware side bug rather than anything wrong with your unit, and nothing about your mining is affected by it. I have passed this to JD, our hardware and firmware lead, with your description. The team is offline for the evening and picks it up tomorrow from 10am ET, and the answer comes straight back to you here. If you want a faster read, JD is very active in our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , where you can mention @nullhashrate. It would help him a lot if you include your exact model and the firmware version from the System page.

Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support

Hi Hal,
Thanks for the detailed response and for forwarding this to JD.
I have two miners running Harlo OS firmware 0.2.101:

  *
NerdQAxe++ Rev 7
  *
Hammer BC04

Both miners exhibit the same issue with the Depth setting.
I performed an additional test by turning Depth OFF and simply pressing F5 to refresh the page. Depth immediately returned to ON.
A few additional observations:

  *
Both miners maintain the same IP addresses, so DHCP address changes are not the issue.
  *
The problem occurs without closing the browser or starting a new session.
  *
I experience the exact same issue when accessing the Harlo OS interface from my cell phone.

Since the problem occurs on two different miner models and across multiple devices, it appears the interface is not properly saving or restoring the Depth preference.
I would appreciate having JD investigate this and consider making the Depth OFF setting persistent across page refreshes and future sessions.
Ideally, once a user disables Depth, it should remain disabled until they manually turn it back on.
Thanks again for your assistance!

PS. I posed the question in Discord but did not get a response. I must be doing something incorrect because ZI hear some beeping in the background but never anyone typing responses.

Dean
Handed to the team · Reproducible web UI bug confirmed across two models, two client devices and a pl

Hi Dean,

That is a textbook bug report, thank you. Your F5 test settles it: if Depth comes back on a plain refresh, with no new session, on two different models, with static IPs, and from your phone as well, then nothing on your side is clearing anything. The preference is simply not being written back to the miner, so every page load serves the default again. It is the web interface in 0.2.101, not your units, and it has no effect on hashing, pools, temperatures or anything the miner actually does.

I have sent JD the full picture: NerdQaxe++ Rev 7 and Hammer BC04, both on 0.2.101, Depth Off reverting on refresh, reproduced on desktop and mobile. That is exactly the detail he needs to reproduce it on his bench.

On a workaround, I would rather be straight with you than invent one. Because the page is served fresh by the miner each time, there is no browser setting or trick on your end that will hold Depth off, it has to come from the firmware. The one thing worth doing is checking the flasher page at harlolabs.com for a build newer than 0.2.101 and, if there is one, running the over the air update, which keeps your settings. JD ships most weeks, so it is worth a look.

About Discord: the beeping without anyone typing means you are sitting in a voice channel rather than a text one. Rejoin at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , leave the voice channel at the bottom left, then pick a text channel in the left sidebar, the Harlo OS or support one, and post there with @nullhashrate in the message. That is JD, and he reads those.

The team is offline for the evening and picks this up tomorrow from 10am ET, and whatever JD comes back with lands in your email.

Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support
